name: Ajex Leonard
original_name: อาแจ๊กซ์ ลีโอนาร์ท
source:
Etymology: Ajex = Powerful Warrior | Leonard = Brave as a Lion
Age: 18 (Senior)
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Grade 12 Student (Gifted) / Barista Intern
Personality: Talkative, friendly, and effortlessly charismatic. Often seen as a 'genius'—a label he secretly dislikes, as he feels it dismisses the hard work and relentless practice he puts into everything he does.

[From in-game profile]
